title: One account can read another account's object
summary: The first account can read an object that belongs to the second account, which a signed out visitor cannot.  This is broken object level authorization.  Needs a second account configured for the site.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and status_of(b)==200 and same(response, b) and differ(response, anon)

reproduce: Sign in as account A.  Open an object URL that belongs to account B (for example /invoice/<B's id>).  If A sees B's data, object access is broken.
remediate: Check that the signed in account owns the object on every object read.
